p1.note: Turkish verse 33 rendered «رخمان» as "Rahmân" (the Name), losing the خ the verse is cited for; changed to «رَخْمان»

p2.note: TR: Raghib passage reordered the examples so "ikincisinde" pointed to height/beauty (Arabic "والحمد يكون في الثاني دون الأول" = spending/courage); order restored. EN: the English text is the commentary on 1:7 ("صراط الذين", badal kinds, أنعمت, غير المغضوب, آمين), not 1:2 (الحمد لله رب العالمين).

Both silently corrected the printed «مَلْك ومُلْك ومَلْك» to «ومِلْك» (now as printed + note); TR also silently changed «إذا مل» to «ما» and verse no. «5 - 6-» to 56, and added an unmarked lemma heading; EN added "only" to «يُضاف إلى غيرِ الملوك» and dropped «إنما» in verse 54. All fixed.

TR: unmarked bracket gloss on the Laylā anecdote (ADDITION) now marked, and silent correction of printed «الحمد الله» now noted; EN: gloss of «أي: رَجَع» was rendered as "said: we belong to Allah…" while the note claimed "translated as written"; now literal with an accurate note.
